title: Morning standup
description: What happened overnight, per project, with decisions needed first.

suggestedChore.reason: Ready when you sit down; posts to Slack only after you approve.

steps.name: collect
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /brief?hours=14 and GET /projects. For each project with activity: last session outcome, cost, parked items with the gap text, assist go-aheads waiting, progress headline and next step. Write STANDUP.md: decisions needed first (parked, go-aheads, unsigned ledgers), then per-project status in two lines each, then spend vs cap and grants used vs unused.

steps.name: post
steps.prompt: Post STANDUP.md as a Slack message to the standup channel configured for this project (ask by parking if you do not know it).
